sources.title: [2001.04758] Deep Audio-Visual Learning: A Survey - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey of recent audio-visual learning development. We divide the current audio-visual learning tasks into four different subfields: audio-visual separation and localization, audio-visual correspondence learning, audio-visual generation, and audio-visual representation learning.
